attributes.action: Stop use of ANPR in poor signal areas
attributes.additional_details: To add stop ederly victim's of technical car park trap cameras.
attributes.background:
Stop use of ANPR cameras in poor signal areas for car parking.
Or sinage BEFORE camera can operate and option to leave site freely.
NOT sited immediately on entrance.

rejection.details:
It's not clear exactly what you are asking for here which is the responsibility of Government or of Parliament, rather than a matter for local authorities and private companies. 

We have accepted petitions more clearly invoking Government responsibility on subjects close to this, such as:

Require car parks to have an on-site payment point: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/716309

If you were to frame your petition in a similar way and re-submit it we could then consider it.
